function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Overview** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• On highways: 55–75 mph (often 70 mph).
• In cities: 25–35 mph.
• School zones: 20 mph (or 25 mph if posted). | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %). | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the vehicle on the right has priority.
• Stop signs: stop, yield to traffic on the right. | | **School Bus** | • Stop on both sides when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | | **Lane Discipline** | • Do not “zig‑zag” or “cut” lanes.
• Use turn signals at least 100 ft before turning. | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• No parking on sidewalks. | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Vehicles that are abandoned or unsafe may be towed. | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Speed cameras enforce posted limits. | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must display valid registration and proof of insurance. | | **Roadside Assistance** | • Texas DOT provides a 24‑hour roadside assistance hotline. | ### Where to Find the Full Text - **Texas Transportation Code** – Chapter 545 (Traffic Rules) and Chapter 545.1 (Traffic Safety). - **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Official website: https://www.txdmv.gov/ - **Texas Legislature Online** – Search for “Transportation Code” for the most recent statutes. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to comply with a particular regulation!
